# benchmark-hundred-step

> Deterministic AI agent benchmark for dependency survival and fault recovery across 25 to 100 tool steps.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-hundred-step
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-hundred-step
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-hundred-step

## Dataset

There are 24 synthetic episodes: six workflow families at 25, 50, 75, and 100
steps. Public seed 20261015 selects transient and rollback faults. Regenerate
with `node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed 20261015 --split public`.

## Grading

The grader replays tool logs. Score weights are survival 60%, final success
25%, injected-failure recovery 10%, and rollback correctness 5%. No LLM judge
is used. See docs/grading.md and docs/task-format.md.

## Exports and commands

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`.
`benchmark-hundred-step/api` exports a fetch-style handler.
`benchmark-hundred-step/mcp` exports MCP builders.

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve,
and mcp. Use `run --provider mock --lengths 25` for a free short run. Long runs
print a cost warning.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The gate writes `artifacts/e2e-report.json`, including a
survival curve by step.
